source_claim: Capcom's official Darkstalkers character articles provide biographies for Demitri Maximoff and Morrigan, Donovan Baine and Hsien-Ko, Lord Raptor and Victor, and Pyron and Jedah; other official Capcom Darkstalkers articles explicitly identify Anakaris, B.B. Hood, Q-Bee, and John/Jon Talbain as franchise characters.
notes: Capcom's official Darkstalkers knowledge series supplies character biographies for Demitri Maximoff and Morrigan (https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/resurrect-your-darkstalkers-knowledge), Donovan Baine and Hsien-Ko (https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/resurrect-your-darkstalkers-knowledge-pt-5), Lord Raptor and Victor (https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/resurrect-your-darkstalkers-knowledge-pt-3), and Pyron and Jedah (https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/resurrect-your-darkstalkers-knowledge-pt-9). Capcom's official announcement for Darkstalkers: The Night Warriors explicitly calls Q-Bee and Anakaris Darkstalkers characters (https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/new-darkstalkers-comic-book-mini-series-announced). Capcom's Darkstalkers Resurrection menu names B.B. Hood/Bulleta (https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/celebrate-darkstalkers-resurrection-with-these-delicious-menu-items); the official Darkstalkers knowledge article says John Talbain and Capcom's official character breakdown uses that spelling (https://news.capcomusa.com/lets/browse/dsr-john-talbain-character-breakdown), matching campaign tag jon_talbain. Each proposed subject is an exact campaign member with direct Capcom franchise evidence; no family, variant, or roster inference beyond the named characters is included.
